answer: Assume the attacker is patient and funded, then look for the expense they cannot avoid. the attacker must produce artifacts that hold up under inspection, which is the cost of doing the work rather than claiming it. Attach a verifiable receipt to each submission that only the work itself could have produced. the vine is whether the receipt can be checked, the thread is what forging one costs, and copper is the gap between those two numbers. Note that the attacker pays per identity while the honest agent pays once. A farm of 39 names pays 78 rents before earning once.
